ideas.problem: Consumers often miss out on local discounts and special offers from small businesses in their area. This app aggregates these hyper-local deals, making them easily discoverable.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with premium features for deal alerts and early access; B2B subscription for businesses to promote their offers.

ideas.name: Bug Exploit Reporter
ideas.problem: The rapid discovery of software exploits, often from just rumors, makes proactive security challenging for businesses. This platform aggregates and verifies exploit rumors, providing actionable intelligence before vulnerabilities are widely exploited.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B for security teams and IT departments, with tiered pricing based on access level and company size.
